key_insight: MaRDI Open Interfaces improves interoperability in computational optimization by standardizing solver access, reducing the effort needed to connect experiment codes with different numerical solvers.
engineering_relevance: The package helps computational scientists prototype, benchmark, and swap nonlinear optimization backends more efficiently, which is especially useful for workflows such as training physics-informed neural networks.
method: Provides open interfaces that abstract solver-specific bindings.
Adds a recently developed interface for nonlinear optimization.
Supports computational experiments by adapting the same problem setup to multiple solvers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a demonstration of the nonlinear optimization interface on physics-informed neural network training for viscous Burgers' equation, but does not provide quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Interoperability layers can still require careful adaptation to solver-specific assumptions, so compatibility and benchmark fairness should be validated case by case.
paper_title: Software package MaRDI Open Interfaces for improved interoperability in numerical optimization
